template_data.headline_html: Five things no one tells you before you certify.

items.title: Eligibility ≠ wins
items.sub: Certifications open the door — they don't hand you the award.

items.title: 8(a) is nine years
items.sub: Know the timeline. Plan for open-market reality when it ends.

items.title: SAM lapse = cert suspended
items.sub: Let your registration expire and your certification goes dark with it.

items.title: Stacking adds lanes, not volume
items.sub: One set-aside type per solicitation — flexibility, not a multiplier.

items.title: Schedule + cert = easier to buy
items.sub: The vehicle and the lane together make award simpler for agencies.
